title: Nervous System
subject: Anatomy and Physiology
description: Neurons, brain structures, and nervous-system divisions.

questions.prompt: What is the basic functional unit of the nervous system?
questions.explanation: The neuron is the basic structural and functional unit of the nervous system.

questions.prompt: Which structures make up the central nervous system?
questions.explanation: The central nervous system consists of the brain and spinal cord.

questions.prompt: Which part of a neuron typically receives signals from other neurons?
questions.explanation: Dendrites typically receive incoming chemical or electrical signals from other neurons.
